description: Install Google Tag Manager (container GTM-N6BF7NP7) in the public-v6 SvelteKit app, add SSR-safe SPA page-view tracking on client-side route changes, extend the vercel.json CSP so GTM/GA/Clarity are not blocked, and add source-scan + unit tests. GA4 and Microsoft Clarity run AS TAGS INSIDE the single GTM container, so only ONE GTM snippet is installed on the site. Analytics were never installed on the live site (no dataLayer/gtm/gtag/clarity anywhere in Public/frontend-v6/src), which is why GA, Clarity, and GTM dashboards are all empty; the strict CSP is the second blocker to pre-empt (same class as the Cloudflare Insights fix in PR #405).
steps: In Public/frontend-v6/src/app.html: add the standard GTM container <script> snippet as HIGH in <head> as reasonable (GTM official placement is top of head; place it right after <meta charset> / the icon links and BEFORE the existing no-flash theme <script>, or as the first script in head). Use the standard snippet hardcoding container id GTM-N6BF7NP7 (it initializes window.dataLayer, pushes gtm.start, and injects https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js). Hardcoding is acceptable and simplest because app.html is a static template that cannot read Vite env; state this choice in findings.
In Public/frontend-v6/src/app.html: add the GTM

Create a tiny SSR-safe helper module Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/analytics/pageview.ts exporting a guarded function (e.g. pushPageView(path: string, title: string)) that pushes { event: 'page_view', page_path, page_title } to window.dataLayer only when window and window.dataLayer exist; no-op otherwise. Keep it minimal, no new dependency.

In Public/frontend-v6/src/routes/+layout.svelte: import afterNavigate from '$app/navigation' and the pushPageView helper; register afterNavigate to push a page-view on every client-side route change using the current url.pathname + url.search and document.title. Guard for browser (the helper already guards window/dataLayer, but keep afterNavigate usage SSR-safe). Do NOT disturb the existing Seo, Chatbot linkify (PR #406), theme, PWA register, sync, inbox, or record->verify redirect behaviors.

In Public/frontend-v6/vercel.json extend ONLY the CSP value (headers -> source '/(.*)' -> Content-Security-Policy). Keep every existing entry byte-identical (including the Cloudflare Insights hosts static.cloudflareinsights.com and cloudflareinsights.com) and keep the CSP one valid single string. Additions: script-src add https://www.googletagmanager.com https://www.clarity.ms https://*.clarity.ms; connect-src add https://www.google-analytics.com https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.analytics.google.com https://www.googletagmanager.com https://*.clarity.ms https://c.bing.com; img-src add https://www.google-analytics.com https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.clarity.ms; ADD a new frame-src directive: frame-src https://www.googletagmanager.com (it does not exist today so framing falls back to default-src 'self' and blocks the GTM noscript iframe). Do NOT remove object-src 'none' / base-uri / frame-ancestors / form-action / manifest-src / worker-src or any existing host. Do NOT add any non-schema key (no 'comment' key) to vercel.json.

Add tests. Create a source-scan test (mirroring src/lib/seo.test.ts and src/lib/pwaManifest.test.ts style, e.g. Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/analytics/gtm.test.ts) that asserts: app.html contains GTM-N6BF7NP7 in BOTH the head <script> snippet AND the <noscript> iframe; the noscript iframe references googletagmanager.com/ns.html; the no-flash theme script and %sveltekit.head%/%sveltekit.body% placeholders remain. Add CSP assertions (either extend the existing seo.test.ts CSP describe block or in the new test): script-src contains https://www.googletagmanager.com; connect-src contains a google-analytics host and a clarity host; there is a frame-src directive containing googletagmanager; default-src 'self' and object-src 'none' still present; the Cloudflare Insights hosts still present; vercel.json has no 'comment' key.

Add a unit test for the pageview helper (e.g. Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/analytics/pageview.test.ts): pushes the expected { event: 'page_view', page_path, page_title } object given a path+title when window.dataLayer exists; is a no-op (throws nothing, pushes nothing) when dataLayer is absent.
acceptance_criteria: app.html contains the GTM container id GTM-N6BF7NP7 in both the head <script> snippet and the <noscript> iframe; the head snippet initializes window.dataLayer and loads gtm.js from www.googletagmanager.com.

The GTM <noscript> iframe is immediately after the opening <body> tag and before the %sveltekit.body% div; existing body attributes, no-flash theme script, fonts, SEO metas, and %sveltekit.head% are unchanged.
+layout.svelte pushes a { event: 'page_view', ... } to window.dataLayer on every client-side navigation via afterNavigate, browser-guarded and SSR-safe, without disturbing existing layout behaviors.

vercel.json CSP is a single valid string containing the new googletagmanager/clarity/google-analytics/bing hosts in the correct directives, a new frame-src with googletagmanager, and still contains default-src 'self', object-src 'none', and both Cloudflare Insights hosts. vercel.json parses as JSON and has no 'comment' key.
No new npm dependency added (package.json dependencies/devDependencies unchanged).
npm run check reports 0 errors / 0 warnings; npm test passes all tests including the new ones; npm run build succeeds within the JS-size budget.
verification: cd Public/frontend-v6 && export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm run check
cd Public/frontend-v6 && export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm run build
Confirm git diff shows changes only under Public/frontend-v6 and package.json dependency lists are unchanged.
findings: Implemented GTM container GTM-N6BF7NP7 in Public/frontend-v6 only; no npm dependency added (git diff package.json empty). GTM container id: HARDCODED as GTM-N6BF7NP7 in both the app.html head <script> snippet (standard async gtm.js loader, initialises window.dataLayer + pushes gtm.start) and the <noscript> iframe (googletagmanager.com/ns.html?id=GTM-N6BF7NP7 right after <body> and before the %sveltekit.body% div). Hardcoding chosen per plan because app.html is a static template that cannot read Vite env; GA4 and Clarity run as tags inside this single container so only one snippet is installed. SPA page views: added src/lib/analytics/pageview.ts (pushPageView guards typeof window and Array.isArray(window.dataLayer), no-op otherwise) and wired afterNavigate in +layout.svelte with an `if (!browser) return` guard, pushing { event:'page_view', page_path: url.pathname+url.search, page_title: document.title }. Existing Seo/Chatbot/theme/PWA/sync/inbox/record->verify redirect behaviours left untouched. CSP: extended ONLY the value string in vercel.json (headers -> source '/(.*)' -> Content-Security-Policy). Existing directives/hosts (including static.cloudflareinsights.com and cloudflareinsights.com) kept byte-identical; no 'comment' or other non-schema key added. FINAL CSP STRING: "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://static.cloudflareinsights.com https://www.googletagmanager.com https://www.clarity.ms https://*.clarity.ms; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com https://drive.google.com https://drive.usercontent.google.com https://files-chhath.shaharpura.com https://www.google-analytics.com https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.clarity.ms; connect-src 'self' https://chhath-public-worker.shaharpura.com https://chhath-server-render.onrender.com https://cloudflareinsights.com https://www.google-analytics.com https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.analytics.google.com https://www.googletagmanager.com https://*.clarity.ms https://c.bing.com; manifest-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; frame-src https://www.googletagmanager.com; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'". Added a brand-new frame-src directive (none existed before) so the GTM noscript iframe is not blocked by default-src fallback. Tests: new src/lib/analytics/gtm.test.ts (source-scan of app.html + vercel.json CSP + layout wiring, node env) and src/lib/analytics/pageview.test.ts (unit, needs '// @vitest-environment jsdom' pragma since the repo default vitest environment is 'node'). Verification: npm run check = 0 errors / 0 warnings; npm test = 326 passed across 21 test files (15 of them the two new analytics files); npm run build succeeded; scripts/first-load-bytes.mjs budget gate exit 0 with worst first load 371160 bytes (index.html), well within the <=700000 budget (GTM gtm.js loads from Google CDN, not bundled). git status confirms changes only under Public/frontend-v6 (src/app.html, src/routes/+layout.svelte, vercel.json, new src/lib/analytics/). Deviation from plan: pageview.test.ts required the jsdom pragma (plan said tests run under jsdom, but this repo's default vitest env is node with per-file @vitest-environment overrides); gtm.test.ts noscript regex uses /<noscript[\s\S]*?<\/noscript>/ (not /<noscript>/) because the noscript tag is multiline.
